description: Was let out, and is not a face in the picture.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Was with the household, and is not a face in the picture.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: A stillness behind glass. She did not speak.
name: Queen Elizabeth

description: Was cried against Scudamore. He kept his seat, as far as you could tell.
name: Henry Wriothesley, 3rd Earl of Southampton

description: Ran against Cumberland. He did not speak to you.
name: Robert Devereux, Earl of Essex

description: Stood off the middle of it.
name: William Shakespeare
